title: QuantMechanica Strategy Risk Contract v1
description: Deterministic bounded-risk contract for a tail-amplifying strategy mechanism (martingale / grid / negative pyramiding / recovery / unbounded multi-position). Authority: OWNER-DEC-D3-20260915 (directive 3 sections 14-21), verbatim at docs/ops/evidence/2026-09-15_continuous_book_evolution/owner_directive_3_max_factory_utilization_verbatim.md. This contract makes tail risk MEASURABLE and BOUNDED; it does not itself approve, deploy, size, or authorize a live weight. A strategy style is never a rejection reason on its own (directive section 14); uncontrolled ruin risk is (directive section 18).

tail_amplifying.description: True when the mechanism amplifies adverse exposure (martingale, grid, negative pyramiding, recovery, unbounded multi-position). A tail-amplifying contract MUST be bounded (finite max_levels and a real equity stop) or intake fails closed with UNBOUNDED_RECOVERY.

max_levels.description: Maximum number of averaging / grid / scale-in levels a single basket may reach. Finite and >= 1 for a bounded mechanism. A value of 0 (or levels_unbounded=true) declares an infinite recovery sequence and is rejected at intake as UNBOUNDED_RECOVERY. Prohibited: 'eventually price must return' without a bounded account-loss condition (directive section 18).

levels_unbounded.description: Optional explicit declaration that the level count is unbounded. When true the mechanism is unbounded regardless of max_levels and is rejected at intake as UNBOUNDED_RECOVERY.

multiplier.description: Per-level size multiplier (geometric) or increment (linear); decimal string preferred. null for flat.

max_open_positions.description: Hard cap on simultaneously open positions/legs for this mechanism.

max_basket_exposure.description: Maximum aggregate basket exposure in lots (or the declared unit). Decimal string preferred.

max_gross_notional.description: Maximum gross notional across all open legs (account currency). Decimal string preferred.

max_margin_pct.description: Maximum margin consumption as a percent of account equity.

max_basket_loss_pct.description: Hard account-loss bound for the whole basket, in percent of account equity. This is the ruin bound: a portfolio-level safety boundary may substitute for individual-trade SLs where the design requires basket management (directive section 18).

type.description: 'none' declares no deterministic emergency exit and is rejected at intake as UNBOUNDED_RECOVERY unless a positive max_basket_loss_pct bound is present.

equity_stop_pct.description: Deterministic equity-stop trigger as percent of account equity. A positive value (or a positive max_basket_loss_pct) is required for a bounded mechanism.

rule.description: Plain-language deterministic rule that flattens all legs (e.g. 'flatten all basket legs when open basket loss reaches max_basket_loss_pct of account equity').

gap_sensitivity.description: How the mechanism behaves through weekend / news gaps that jump past intermediate levels. Use NOT_EVALUATED / UNKNOWN when not yet measured.

spread_slippage_sensitivity.description: How basket P&L degrades under wider spread / realistic slippage (tie to Q06 HARSH stress). Use NOT_EVALUATED / UNKNOWN when not yet measured.

max_adverse_levels.description: Deepest level reached in the worst observed historical adverse run (integer), or NOT_EVALUATED / EVIDENCE_MISSING.

max_drawdown_pct.description: Worst observed basket drawdown percent, or NOT_EVALUATED / EVIDENCE_MISSING.

evidence.description: Path to the sealed evidence stream/report (Q08/Q14 or demo), or EVIDENCE_MISSING.

scenario.description: Preregistered stress scenario (e.g. adverse trend that hits max_levels then continues).

result_pct.description: Account-loss percent under the stress scenario, or NOT_EVALUATED / EVIDENCE_MISSING.

evidence.description: Path to the stress evidence, or EVIDENCE_MISSING.
